name: iam:PassRole on * WITHOUT any workload-execution primitive - not escalation
note: PassRole alone grants nothing exploitable: there is no service action here that would consume the passed role.
rationale: iam:PassRole only matters when paired with a service action that consumes a role (ec2:RunInstances, lambda:CreateFunction, ecs:RunTask, etc.). To pass a role you must call an API that accepts one; on its own PassRole cannot launch or configure anything, so no privilege-boundary crossing occurs. This policy has iam:PassRole plus a non-consuming action (s3:GetObject) - no execution primitive - so no PASSROLE-* escalation path exists and none may be flagged. (This is the canonical 'do NOT flag PassRole alone' rule; a broad DATA-EXFIL observation on s3:GetObject * is a separate matter.) Ref: AWS docs, iam:PassRole is used in conjunction with the service action that receives the role.
